BiblicalUsage: lêylᵉyâʼ means night, and it does large work in the story. In Daniel 2:19, "Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision."; and in Daniel 5:30, "In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.". In Daniel 7:2, "I saw in my vision by night"; and in Daniel 7:13, "I saw in the night visions".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe night is when God speaks in Daniel — the secret revealed in a night vision, the king slain in that night, and the Son of man coming with the clouds. I hold that the darkest hours in Babylon were the clearest hours of revelation. My position is that I will not fear the night visions; the God who gives them is the God who explains them.
